item.text: [{"task_id":"470c91de","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    negative = int(round(params['motion'][0]))","    positive = int(round(params['motion'][1]))","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    height, width = grid.shape","    for value in np.unique(grid):","        color = int(value)","        if color == background or color == marker:","            continue","        points = np.argwhere(grid == color)","        top = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","        bottom = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","        left = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","        right = int(np.max(points[:, 1]))","        vertical = 0","        horizontal = 0","        for row in [top, bottom]:","            for column in [left, right]:","                if int(grid[row, column]) == marker:","                    vertical = negative if row == top else positive","                    horizontal = negative if column == left else positive","        for row in range(top, bottom + 1):","            for column in range(left, right + 1):","                target_row = row + vertical","                target_column = column + horizontal","                if 0 <= target_row < height and 0 <= target_column < width:","                    result[target_row, target_column] = color","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"motion":[2]},"params":{"colors":[7,8],"motion":[-1,1]},"rationale":"Each colored rectangle has an 8 at one corner.
